name: Mauritius Atoll
source:
Mauritius was shattered into islands by a century-old eruption. Some ferry across its waters; others search underwater for ancient 21st-century artifacts.

You set out from Rose Hill Cove – what will you choose: a ferry trip to New Chagos, a wild night with your friend, or a treasure hunt beneath the waves?

[From [url=https://guimero-games.itch.io/mauritius-atoll]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
毛里求斯因长达一个世纪的火山喷发而分裂成岛屿。一些渡船穿越其水域；其他人则在水下寻找21世纪的古代文物。

你从玫瑰山湾出发 - 你会选择什么：前往新查戈斯的渡轮之旅、与朋友一起度过狂野的夜晚，还是在海浪下寻宝？

[来自[url=https://guimero-games.itch.io/mauritius-atoll]Itch.io[/url]]
